plugins.name: navi-recap
plugins.description: Turn git commit history into a product-evolution story and a polished single-file HTML slide deck. Mines the canonical master across sibling repos (remote master if the local clone is off master), verifies flows in code before drawing them, narrates for non-engineers, then builds and visually verifies the deck. Supports a closed time range. Install separately.

plugins.name: product-recap
plugins.description: Turn one or more repos' git history into a product-evolution story and a single-file HTML slide deck. Run from any directory; always recaps the canonical master branch. A local clone is mined only when it's on master; if it's on another branch, or cwd is not a repo (resolve the repo from natural language against the Mercaso org), it reads master from the remote instead. Merge sibling repos into one deck, scope to a sub-path, pick a time window (open-ended or a closed start–end range); verify flows in code, narrate for non-engineers, build and visually verify the deck. Install separately.

plugins.name: html-ppt
plugins.description: HTML PPT Studio — author professional static HTML presentations driven by templates: 36 themes, 31 layouts, 27 CSS + 20 canvas-FX animations, a token-based design system, and a keyboard-navigable presenter mode. Use for any PPT/slides/deck/keynote/幻灯片/小红书图文 request. Vendored from lewislulu/html-ppt-skill (MIT). Install separately.
